name: belltower.sources.list
description: List the sources Belltower carries, with their kind: official (a public body that issues notices), newsroom, or aggregator (it republishes other sources). items is the number of items from that source. Belltower does not rank sources and does not say which one is right. No side effects.

name: belltower.areas.list
description: List the areas items are tagged with. Areas form a tree of three levels: city, district, neighbourhood. path is the chain from the city down to the area. With id, only that area and the areas inside it are returned. Errors: not_found. No side effects.

id.description: Area ID: return this area and every area inside it.

name: belltower.items.list
description: List or search items (articles and public notices), newest first. Each entry shows the item as it stands now: its latest revision number, type (original, update, correction or retraction), headline, topics, areas, priority and times, with status current, corrected or retracted. The filters start/end, area_id, topic, min_priority and query are checked against every revision, earlier ones included, and an item is listed when at least one of its revisions passes all of them; matched_revisions names those revisions, so a claim that was later corrected can still be found and is shown as belonging to an earlier revision. Without such a filter matched_revisions lists every revision. start and end select revisions by received_at, the time they reached Belltower. query is plain word matching in headline and body: every word of the query must appear as a whole word, in any letter case. Belltower does not group copies into one story and does not label anything as outdated: a copy names what it copied in based_on. Reading or listing an item never marks it as read. Errors: not_found (an unknown source or area), invalid_window (end is not after start). No match returns an empty list. No side effects.

start.description: Only revisions received at or after this time, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

end.description: Only revisions received before this time, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

area_id.description: Only revisions tagged with this area, with an area inside it or with an area that contains it.

kind.description: Only articles or only public notices.

min_priority.description: Only revisions with at least this priority.

query.description: Words to look for in the headline and body of every revision.

changed_since_read.description: true: only items with a revision newer than the newest one marked as read. false: only items without one (never read, or read at the latest revision).

cursor.description: Opaque value from next_cursor of the previous page.

name: belltower.items.get
description: Read one item. Returns its latest revision unless revision is given, and always names what was returned: revision, type and is_latest. revisions lists every revision of the item with its number, type, times and, for a correction or a retraction, the publisher's note. Every revision has published_at (as its publisher states it) and received_at (when it reached Belltower); a public notice also has the effective period it announces, and effect (upcoming, in_effect or ended) follows that period and the current time. A retraction has no body: it carries the publisher's note, and the earlier revisions stay readable by number. based_on is the publisher's own statement of which revision of which other item this revision copied or reported on; referenced_by lists every revision of other items that names this item as its basis, each with the revision it used (used_revision) and its own times. Belltower states these links and draws no conclusion from them. last_read_revision, read_revisions and changed_since_read come from the account's read marks; reading an item here does not create one (use reading.mark). Errors: not_found (an unknown item, or a revision number the item does not have). No side effects.

revision.description: Revision number to return; the latest when left out.

name: belltower.follows.list
description: List the account's follow rules. A rule matches a revision when every filter it has is met: the item's source is one of its sources, one of the revision's topics is one of its topics, the priority is at least min_priority, and one of the revision's areas overlaps one of its areas (the same area, or one contains the other). A paused rule matches nothing. No side effects.

state.description: Only active or only paused rules.

name: belltower.reading.list
description: List the account's read marks, newest first: which revision of which item the person was shown, and when. is_latest says whether that revision is still the item's latest. A read mark exists only when reading.mark was called or the loaded history had it; reading items does not create marks. id filters by item. Errors: not_found. No side effects.

id.description: Item ID: only marks of this item.

cursor.description: Opaque value from next_cursor of the previous page.

name: belltower.clippings.list
description: List the account's clippings, newest first. A clipping holds one revision of an item with a note, an optional reference to what relies on it (linked_object) and a watch setting. is_current is false (state behind) when the item has a newer revision than the one the clipping holds. history lists the earlier versions of the clipping: the revision, note, reference and watch setting it held until replaced_at. id filters by item. Errors: not_found. No side effects.

id.description: Item ID: only the clipping of this item.

name: belltower.notifications.list
description: List the notifications Belltower wrote for this account, newest first. One is written when a revision arrives (a new item included) and an active follow rule matches it, or the account was already notified about that item, or it watches a clipping of it. kind follows the revision: item.published, item.updated, item.corrected or item.retracted. reasons says why it was written (follow, earlier_notification, watched_clipping) and matched_follow_ids names the rules that match this revision, possibly none. Every notification has a release time. State is held before that time, released from then on, and superseded when a later revision of the same item arrived while it was still held: a superseded notification was never released, and superseded_by names the one that replaced it. id filters by item; start and end select by the time a notification was created. Errors: not_found, invalid_window (end is not after start). No side effects.

id.description: Item ID: only notifications about this item.

state.description: Only notifications in this state, as of now.

start.description: Only notifications created at or after this time, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

end.description: Only notifications created before this time, ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

cursor.description: Opaque value from next_cursor of the previous page.

name: belltower.preferences.get
description: Read the account preferences: time zone, quiet hours, the daily digest time, how corrections and retractions are delivered (as_item: like the item's other notifications; immediate: at once) and whether notifications are also prepared as email. in_quiet_hours and next_digest_at are worked out for the current time. No side effects.

name: belltower.follows.create
description: Create a follow rule from any of a list of sources, a list of areas and a list of topics, with a minimum priority and a delivery. At least one source, area or topic is needed. The rule applies to revisions that arrive from now on; nothing is notified for what was already published. The result id is the new rule. Errors: not_found (an unknown source or area), already_following (a rule with the same sources, areas, topics and minimum priority exists: change that one with follows.update), limit_exceeded (the account already has 20 rules), invalid_arguments (no source, area or topic).

source_ids.description: Sources to follow; leave out or empty for any source.

area_ids.description: Areas to follow. A revision matches when one of its areas is one of these, lies inside one of them or contains one of them. Leave out or empty for any area.

topics.description: Topics to follow; leave out or empty for any topic.

min_priority.description: Lowest priority that matches: routine (everything), important, or urgent.

delivery.description: immediate: notify when the revision arrives (held over quiet hours unless it is urgent). digest: notify at the next daily digest time.

expected_version.description: Version from the latest result you read. A stale version is rejected with stale_version.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this write. Repeating it with the same input returns the stored result. This is Core's idempotency key, not a record ID.

name: belltower.follows.update
description: Change a follow rule: its filters, its delivery, or paused (true pauses it, false resumes it). Only the fields present in patch change; a list replaces the old list. Later notifications follow the change; notifications already written keep their release time. Pausing a rule stops discovery through it. It does not withdraw notifications already written, and a later revision of an item the account was already notified about still notifies. id is the rule ID. Errors: not_found (the rule, or an unknown source or area), already_following (the change would make it the same as another rule), invalid_arguments (an empty patch, or a rule left with no source, area or topic).

source_ids.description: Sources to follow; leave out or empty for any source.

area_ids.description: Areas to follow. A revision matches when one of its areas is one of these, lies inside one of them or contains one of them. Leave out or empty for any area.

topics.description: Topics to follow; leave out or empty for any topic.

min_priority.description: Lowest priority that matches: routine (everything), important, or urgent.

delivery.description: immediate: notify when the revision arrives (held over quiet hours unless it is urgent). digest: notify at the next daily digest time.

paused.description: true pauses the rule; false resumes it.

expected_version.description: Version from the latest result you read. A stale version is rejected with stale_version.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this write. Repeating it with the same input returns the stored result. This is Core's idempotency key, not a record ID.

name: belltower.follows.remove
description: Remove a follow rule. From then on it brings no notification for a new item or for an item the account was not notified about before. Notifications already written stay, and a later revision of an item the account was already notified about still notifies. id is the rule ID. Errors: not_found.

expected_version.description: Version from the latest result you read. A stale version is rejected with stale_version.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this write. Repeating it with the same input returns the stored result. This is Core's idempotency key, not a record ID.

name: belltower.preferences.update
description: Change account preferences. Only the fields present in patch change. Quiet hours hold a new immediate notification until they end, unless the revision is urgent; a digest notification is released at the next daily digest time. Notifications already written keep their release time. Turning email_notices off stops new email copies; the notification log is still written. Errors: invalid_timezone, invalid_arguments (an empty patch, quiet hours that start and end at the same time, or a digest time inside the quiet hours).

timezone.description: IANA time zone, for example America/Chicago.

quiet_hours.description: Any of enabled, start and end (HH:MM in the account time zone); fields left out keep their value.

digest_time.description: Daily digest time, HH:MM in the account time zone. It cannot lie inside the quiet hours.

corrections.description: as_item: a correction or retraction is delivered like the item's other notifications. immediate: it is delivered at once.

email_notices.description: Whether a new notification is also prepared as an email message for Mail.

expected_version.description: Version from the latest result you read. A stale version is rejected with stale_version.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this write. Repeating it with the same input returns the stored result. This is Core's idempotency key, not a record ID.

name: belltower.reading.mark
description: Record that the person was shown an item at one revision. Without revision the item's latest revision is marked. The mark keeps the revision and the current time, and items then show changed_since_read when a newer revision exists. id is the item ID. Errors: not_found (an unknown item, or a revision the item does not have), already_read (that revision is already marked).

revision.description: The revision that was read; the latest when left out.

expected_version.description: Version from the latest result you read. A stale version is rejected with stale_version.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this write. Repeating it with the same input returns the stored result. This is Core's idempotency key, not a record ID.

name: belltower.clippings.add
description: Clip an item at its latest revision, with an optional note, an optional reference to what relies on it and a choice to watch it. A watched clipping brings a notification with immediate delivery for every later revision of that item, also when no follow rule matches. id is the item ID; the result id is the new clipping. Errors: not_found, already_clipped (the item already has a clipping: change it with clippings.update), limit_exceeded (the account already has 100 clippings).

linked_object.description: A reference to what relies on this item, for example { app_id: "calendar", object_type: "event", object_id: "..." }. Stored as given and never opened.

watch.description: Whether later revisions of the item notify the account; false when left out.

expected_version.description: Version from the latest result you read. A stale version is rejected with stale_version.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this write. Repeating it with the same input returns the stored result. This is Core's idempotency key, not a record ID.

name: belltower.clippings.update
description: Change a clipping: move it to a newer revision of its item, change its note or its reference, or turn watching on or off. Only the fields present in patch change; note or linked_object set to null removes it. The version it held before is kept in its history. Ending a watch stops the notifications that depended on the watch alone; it does not stop later revisions of an item the account was already notified about. id is the clipping ID. Errors: not_found (the clipping, or a revision the item does not have), invalid_revision (the revision is not newer than the one the clipping holds), invalid_arguments (an empty patch).

revision.description: A newer revision of the item for the clipping to hold.

note.description: New note, or null to remove it.

linked_object.description: New reference, or null to remove it.

watch.description: Whether later revisions of the item notify the account.

expected_version.description: Version from the latest result you read. A stale version is rejected with stale_version.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this write. Repeating it with the same input returns the stored result. This is Core's idempotency key, not a record ID.

name: belltower.clippings.remove
description: Remove a clipping with its history. The item and its read marks are not touched. id is the clipping ID. Errors: not_found.
